lines.text: One guard. Fifteen dark rooms. All of them, his to watch.
Somewhere inside, an intruder. Invisible, until his torch flicks on.
So the guard searches, room by room. He can only look at one at a time.
Room ten. Gone, before he looks.
Room three, while he watches eight. Twelve, while he watches five. Every time, too late.
The building is the radio spectrum. Every room, a frequency band.
The intruder, an unknown emitter. The guard, the receiver.
The signal was there. The receiver was looking elsewhere.
